description: A fictional stylised low-poly video-game prop, a chunky toy-like cartoon 3D game asset (not a real object, no working parts). In the middle a big dark grey drum, as wide as it is long, lying along the prop's axis, with six large round holes in its front face around a small orange centre cap and six shallow flat grooves along its outside. In front of the drum a short fat round dark grey tube with a thick orange ring round its open front end; under the tube a matte black vertical front handle with ribbed sides. A slim dark grey frame bar runs over the top of the drum from the tube to the rear, carrying a short flat ridged strip with a boxy matte black sight box on it; the sight box has a flat orange window. Behind the drum a matte black handle raked backward with a small curved lever inside a rounded loop, and a matte black open shoulder piece: two thin bars spreading from the frame to a tall flat ribbed end pad. Bright orange accents: the ring round the front end of the tube, the small centre cap on the drum's front face, the window of the sight box, and a small latch on the left flank of the end pad. The right flank is plain.

sides: the small orange latch on the end pad is on the left flank; the right flank is plain; everything else is symmetric left to right.
